description.value: Liquor Express is a liquor retail store on Keating Cross Road on the Saanich Peninsula, serving the area between Victoria and Sidney. The store sells beer, wine, and spirits and may be a convenient stop for cycling tourists passing through on routes connecting the ferry terminal at Swartz Bay with the broader peninsula. No cycling-specific amenity information is currently verifiable.
